list.name: engine_type
list.label: Engine
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "telemetry", tag: "engine_type", predicate: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}", start: -30d)

list.name: engine_model
list.label: Engine model
list.query:
import "array"
named = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "engine" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.engine_model or exists r.engine_type)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if exists r.engine_model then r.engine_model else r.engine_type}))
  |> group()
none = array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, _value: "not reported"}])
union(tables: [named, none])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nav" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.lat and exists r.lon)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "lat", "lon"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

import "math"
p = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nav" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon" or r._field == "heading" or r._field == "cog" or r._field == "sog"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vessel"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.lat and exists r.lon and exists r.sog and (exists r.cog or exists r.heading))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sog >= 0.5)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with crs: if exists r.cog then r.cog else r.heading}))
a = p |> map(fn: (r) => ({seq: 0, lat: r.lat, lon: r.lon}))
b = p |> map(fn: (r) => ({seq: 1,
      lat: r.lat + r.sog / 600.0 * math.cos(x: r.crs * math.pi / 180.0),
      lon: r.lon + r.sog / 600.0 * math.sin(x: r.crs * math.pi / 180.0) / math.cos(x: r.lat * math.pi / 180.0)}))
union(tables: [a, b])
  |> sort(columns: ["seq"])

import "math"
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "nav" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon"))
      or (r._measurement == "mission" and (r._field == "base_lat" or r._field == "base_lon")))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vessel"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.lat and exists r.lon and exists r.base_lat and exists r.base_lon)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      p1 = r.lat * math.pi / 180.0
      p2 = r.base_lat * math.pi / 180.0
      dp = p2 - p1
      dl = (r.base_lon - r.lon) * math.pi / 180.0
      a = math.sin(x: dp / 2.0) * math.sin(x: dp / 2.0)
          + math.cos(x: p1) * math.cos(x: p2) * math.sin(x: dl / 2.0) * math.sin(x: dl / 2.0)
      return {_value: 2.0 * 6371008.8 * math.asin(x: math.sqrt(x: a)) / 1852.0}
  })
